# UQDA Core v0.1.8

This maintenance release fixes command discovery after installing UQDA on
Windows.

## Windows

- The MSI now adds the UQDA installation directory to the system `PATH`.
- New PowerShell windows can run `uqda.exe` and `uqdactl.exe` without
  changing directories or using a full path.
- Uninstalling the MSI removes the PATH entry automatically.
- Windows defaults and the MSI service now consistently read configuration
  from `%ProgramData%\UQDA\uqda.conf`.
- Configuration generation now quotes paths and fails cleanly if creating the
  persistent configuration does not succeed.
- English and Arabic documentation now explains PowerShell's `.\` current
  directory rule, service management, status commands, and configuration
  location.

Existing installations should upgrade to v0.1.8 and open a new PowerShell
window so it receives the updated system environment.
